s: Din haqqiddush bebet hakkeneset ubo d' seipim: chakamim harishonim tiqqenu leqaddesh al hayyayin bebet hakkeneset, kede lehotzi et haorechim sheen lahem yayin hashshobetim bachadarim hassemukim lebet hakkeneset, veokelim sham miyyad achar qiddush zeh, shehare qiddush zeh lahem hu bimqom seudda, shebbeshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur haya omer qiddush zeh hayu haorechim kebar bechadrehem veshomeim mishsham et haqqiddush veyotzein bo. Abal hatztzibbur enan yotzeim bo ap im nitkavvenu latzet, kevan sheen shomein oto bimqom seudda:

Veap akshav sheen lanu orechim hashshobetim etzel bet hakkeneset lehotziam yede chobatam, ap al pi ken nohagim leqaddesh bebet hakkeneset al hayyayin, lepi shettaqqanat chakamim lo botla ap al pi shebbatel hattaam shebbiglalo tiqqenu, kemo beraka meen z' sheomerim ap bizman hazzeh shebbatte kenesiyyot shellanu hem beyishshub, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"ch. Veap sheyyesh choleqim umeararim al minhag zeh shennahagu leqaddesh bebet hakkeneset akshav sheen orechim, veken nitpashshet hamminhag bimdinot harbeh shello leqaddesh bebet hakkeneset, mikkol maqom bimdinot ellu shennahagu bo — en lebattel hamminhag, ki haiqqar kassebara harishona. Veyesh miggedole haddor shehaya noheg liqnot mehaqqahal mitzvat hayyayin shel qiddush zeh, sheyyittenennu hu mishshello velo acher. Veken nohagim akshav bemiqtzat medinot liqnoto bedamim yeqarim. (Veen lebattel hamminhag ki harbeh geonim yisseduhu):

Hamqaddesh bebet hakkeneset asur lo litom mehakkos, shehare hu eno yotze beqiddush zeh, veasur litom kelum qodem qiddush. Ella ketzad yaaseh shello tehe birkat "bore peri haggapen" lebattala? Yatim mehakkos leqatan shehiggia lechinnuk, vehaqqatan yishma habberaka mimmennu veyotze bah yede chobato, venimtza shello berak lebattala, shemmuttar lehaakil et haqqatan qodem qiddush, ben shel layla ben shel yom, veasur leannoto, shello aseru lehaakilo issur beyadayim ella keshehammaakal asur mitztzad atzmo, kegon terepa vekayyotze bah, abal keshehammaakal muttar mechamat atzmo, ella shehu zeman haasur baakila — muttar lehaakil leqatan, shehare maakilim haqqetannim beyom hakkippurim, apillu qatan sheen bo chashash sakkana im yitanneh. Veim en qatan bebet hakkeneset — yitom hamqaddesh atzmo, o adam acher, veyishteh keshiur shechayyabim lebarek acharayv beraka acharona, dehaynu rebiit, sheyyesh omerim sheyyotze bezeh yede qiddush bimqom seudda kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"g. Velaken yehe bedato latzet yede chobato beqiddush zeh, sheim lo ken asur litom qodem qiddush. Veap al pi ken yakol hu lachazor uleqaddesh bebeto, kede lehotzi et ishto ubanayv ubene beto im enam yodeim leqaddesh beatzman, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:
Nahagu laamod beshaa shehashsheliach tzibbur meqaddesh bebet hakkeneset. Veameru harishonim shezzeh moil laayeput habbirkayim:
